configurations.rationale: Instrumented Original, rerun on fresh seeds.

The measured combination preserves all six own targets in 3/3 and lowers the mean time in both large cases. Confirm this signal and its reliability with fresh seeds; no additive synergy or universal improvement is presumed.

A distinct local-neighborhood breadth question: K=2 halves swap candidates per local step, reaches all three tail targets in 3/3, and wins all three large-case paired times, but its medium mean is worse due to one slow seed. Test whether quality is retained and whether timing/tails improve with ten fresh seeds across six cases; no doubled speed is inferred from halved checks.

schedule_policy: Fresh heldout-stage RNG; shuffle the same Original and locked candidates within sixty instance-seed blocks. All observations new.
target_scope: Frozen published and maximum nominal baseline objectives; neither implies optimality.
timing_scope: Full per-cell search wall budget. Nominal observations exclude overshoot. Misses are censored at their own horizon. No pooled mixed-budget time.
primary_analysis: For each of the six reserved instances separately, compare each prelocked candidate against Original using the mean paired difference in time capped at the frozen own-target horizon, together with nominal quality and hit counts. Both target labels coincide on this panel and are one numerical outcome. No retuning, pooled times or automatic significance claim.

analysis_plan.unit: One complete solver run; ten matched seeds per instance/configuration. Blocks/checkpoints are not replicates.
quality: Nominal best, mean, worst, sample SD
Own-target and published-target hits out of ten; no change to frozen targets if a new best is found
time: All observed target times and explicit censoring at each instance horizon
Mean capped time, mean among successes with denominator, median and range
All ten paired differences at both frozen targets; count wins/ties/losses without treating subsecond millisecond differences as substantive

uncertainty.method: Paired bootstrap percentile interval for the mean capped-time difference, shown only for complete ten-pair cells.
uncertainty.caveat: Descriptive uncertainty with n=10; not simultaneous intervals or a significance declaration across the 12 contrasts. Capped outcomes are not latent uncensored arrival times.

analysis_plan.work: Nominal whole-horizon counters and rates by configuration; no exclusive-phase timing or inferred first-target work.
analysis_plan.conditional_mean: Always display successful-run denominator; never replace the capped mean by this conditional statistic.
analysis_plan.comparison_scope: Reserved-case assessment of the same three locked configurations on six preselected cases, with fresh seeds. No pooled development/heldout n and no post-confirmation replacement.

inference: Reserved-case evaluation of three prelocked configurations on six hash-selected cases, ten fresh paired seeds. No tuning or replacement after development confirmation. Both target labels coincide numerically on this panel and are not independent evidence. No automatic significance or benchmark-wide superiority claim.
